title: Dragon's Armor HUD
description: Adds a simple yet customizable armor HUD display
body:
## **Dragon's Armor HUD**

This 1.21.11 client side mod adds a configurable armor HUD which you can customize freely. 

### This mod has the following features:
- An armor hud which displays armor in 5 different ways.
- A config menu to switch between features, like disabling text colors, changing armor layouts, etc.
- mod **Modmenu**, mod **Dragon's Projectile Fix** support.
